column1: # 沃尔玛官方「多久生效 / 多久处理完」口径登记表(2026-09-12 全量核验,来源全部是官方站点)
# 存在的理由:在途 feed 到底等多久才该判死,此前只能拍脑袋。官方虽然**不给 feed 级的最长
# 处理时间**(只给轮询节奏),但给了各操作的**业务生效窗口**;而 feed 落定必然发生在业务
# 生效之前 ⇒ 生效窗口的上限就是"还在正常处理"的上限。最慢的一档是 72 小时。
# ⚠ 只登记官方原句,不写推断;推断写在 docs/feed_closure_audit.md。
# 列:操作 | 官方值 | 我方判死期限(留余量) | 官方原句 | 官方URL | 核对日期
操作
feed 轮询节奏(INPROGRESS)
column2: 15 分钟 → 1 小时 → 2 小时 → 此后每 4 小时
column4: If the feed is INPROGRESS, poll until the status changes. Recommended intervals for item feeds: 15 minutes, 1 hour, 2 hours, every 4 hours

column1: feed 级最长处理时间
column2: **官方未给**(四页核验均无:feeds-overview / list-all-feed-statuses / getallfeedstatuses / item-setup-sla)
column3: 按下面各 feedType 的生效窗口反推

column1: feed 状态保留窗口
逐条 SYSTEM_ERROR / TIMEOUT_ERROR 重试
column4: A downstream system returned an error. Wait at least one hour and try again.

column1: 批量建品/改品处理(MP_ITEM / MP_MAINTENANCE)
column4: A bulk item submission (create or update) takes up to four hours to process.

column1: 提交成功 → 数据可查(catalog 可见)
column4: There is an SLA of up to six hours between when an item is successfully submitted and when the data is available.

column1: Hazmat 人工审核(Walmart-fulfilled)
column4: Walmart fulfilled submissions that require Hazmat checks can go into a manual Walmart associate review process. The SLA for this review can take up to 48 hours.

column1: item setup 状态更新(Seller Center 侧)
column2: 最长 24 小时;危险品合规审核最长 3 个工作日
column4: After submitting your item, you can track its status from the Activity Feed in Seller Center. Updates may take up to 24 hours. / Updates may take up to 24 hours. But if your item has a hazardous material, it will be held again for a compliance review of up to 3 business days.

column1: 按匹配上架(MP_ITEM_MATCH / set up items by match)
column2: 最长 24 小时;沃尔玛无法导入时文件处理最长 72 小时
column4: Updates may take up to 24 hours. / In some cases, it may take up to 72 hours for a file to process if Walmart is unable to import the items.

column1: 批量改价(price / PRICE_AND_PROMOTION)
column2: SLA 15 分钟;提交后至少等 5 分钟再查
column4: The bulk price update Service Level Agreement (SLA) is 15 minutes. / After submitting the price feed, wait at least 5 minutes before checking whether the bulk price update was successful.

column1: ⚠ 新建 item 发批量改价的前置条件
column2: WPID 已分配 **且建品满 24 小时**
column4: For newly created items, ensure that the Walmart Part ID (WPID) has been assigned and that at least 24 hours have passed since item creation before submitting a bulk price update feed.

column1: 单品改价(Seller Center)
column4: Price changes may take up to four hours to update.

column1: 库存更新(inventory / MP_INVENTORY)
column2: 最快 15 分钟,最长 4 小时反映到 Walmart.com
column4: Updates can appear in as quickly as 15 minutes or may take up to four hours. / it could take up to four hours for the update to reflect on Walmart.com

column1: 停用/退役(RETIRE_ITEM)
column2: 通常几分钟;catalog 最长 48 小时
column4: it can take up to 48 hours for items to be retired from our catalog / the catalog update itself can take up to 48 hours

column1: 删除(DELETE_ITEM)
column2: 48 小时内删除;最长 72 小时从 Catalog 消失
column4: Your selected items will be deleted within 48 hours. / It may take up to 72 hours before your items are removed from your Catalog.

column1: 价格/运费违规修好后自动重新上架
column4: If prices change on Walmart.com or monitored competing websites and the item now adheres to pricing rules, Walmart will automatically republish the offer, typically within 48 hours.
